story: Crater of Diamonds State Park is a 911-acre Arkansas state park in Pike County, Arkansas, in the United States. It features a 37.5-acre plowed field which is one of the few diamond-bearing sites accessible to the public. Diamonds have been discovered here continuously since 1906.
matters: The park is situated over an eroded lamproite volcanic pipe where visitors can hunt for diamonds and other semi-precious gems. Over 75,000 diamonds have been found in the crater.
name: Crater of Diamonds State Park
